[New]

🆕 **Global image tokens**: New global tokens **"Parcel image"** and **"Latest mail scan"** are always filled and can be used in **any Flow**, including **Advanced Flows with several trigger cards**. Trigger tokens (such as *Sender* or *Parcel image* of a specific card) only exist when that card started the Flow, which caused **"Missing token value"** when another card fired.

[Fix]

🖼️ **Parcel image in Flows**: Fixed the parcel image in Flow cards (for example a **WhatsApp** message) showing a **Homey logo** or failing with **"Missing token value: package_image"**. Separately created trigger images (1.2.11) were not reliably accepted by Homey.

🔄 **Right status on the image**: Parcel Flows now use the proven **My Delivery** image again. Right before each trigger it is set to **that parcel and its current status**, so the image always matches the notification instead of showing the previous status.

[Improvement]

🚚 **Only parcels on the way**: Images are only drawn for parcels that have **not been delivered yet**. Flows for delivered parcels reuse the current *My Delivery* image without extra rendering.

📦 **Several parcels at once**: When several parcels change in the same sync, the image is redrawn for **each parcel just before its own Flow** fires.

🧠 **Light on memory**: No extra images are kept in memory; the image is only redrawn when a Flow actually fires or when what *My Delivery* should show has changed.

🌟 Enjoy the improved PostNL v1.2.12 App with the right parcel image in every Flow.
